headline: PALADIN DRILLS 4.25% U₃O₈ AT BRAND-NEW ATLAS BODY — 7 OF 8 HOLES HIT, 17.5m COMPOSITE AT PLS ATHABASCA (ASX:PDN)
snippet: Paladin Energy (ASX:PDN) announced June 25 a new high-grade uranium body — the Atlas discovery — at its Patterson Lake South (PLS) project in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin, with 7 of 8 exploration drillholes intersecting significant uranium mineralisation 3.5km south of the Triple R deposit. Discovery hole PLS26-708B returned a 17.5m composite across three intervals averaging 1.75% U₃O₈, including 3.0m averaging 4.25% U₃O₈ from 190m — grades comparable to Triple R's early discovery intercepts — and the company immediately re-mobilised rigs after the seasonal break to follow up both Atlas and additional priority targets.

headline: NEXGOLD INFILL HITS 61.22 g/t AU OVER 12m IN NOVA SCOTIA — 685 g/t PEAK; 30,000m PROGRAM 65% DONE (TSXV:NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV:NEXG) reported June 25 two standout intercepts from its 30,000m, 600-hole RC infill program at the Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia: RC-26-073 returned 61.22 g/t gold over 12.0m from 18m depth — including 685 g/t gold over 1.0m — and RC-26-037 returned 5.85 g/t over 13.0m. With 65% of the program complete, initial results are confirming the grade tenor and structural continuity of near-surface mineralisation at a resolution not previously drilled, data that feeds directly into an updated resource estimate underpinning Goldboro's feasibility pathway.

headline: NEWCORE GOLD ENCHI PFS: $351M CAPEX, 104,000 OZ/YR, 9.3-YEAR MINE LIFE — MINING LEASE APPLICATION NEXT (TSXV:NCAU)
snippet: Newcore Gold (TSXV:NCAU) published June 24 a Pre-Feasibility Study for its Enchi Gold Project in Ghana based on a conventional 5.5-Mtpa open pit CIL operation: $351 million initial capex, roughly 104,000 payable ounces per year, a 9.3-year mine life, and a 24-month construction schedule. The company will use the PFS immediately to apply for a mining lease — a milestone that typically triggers the re-rating cycle for West African juniors and signals the end of the project's exploration-stage discount.

headline: OMAI DRILLS 7.26 g/t AU OVER 34.8m AT WENOT — 5 RIGS, 27,770m DONE; UPDATED PEA ON TRACK FOR Q3 2026 (TSXV:OMG)
snippet: Omai Gold Mines (TSXV:OMG) reported June 24 that hole 26ODD-185 at its Wenot Deposit in Guyana returned 7.26 g/t gold over 34.8m, with 15 discrete gold zones from 200m to 540m downhole — part of a 50,000m, five-rig program that has now completed 27,770m across 58 holes. Phase 1 metallurgical tests confirm 93–95% gold recoveries under standard CIL processing, and an updated PEA targeting Q3 2026 will incorporate both Wenot and the adjacent Gilt underground deposit.

headline: ENDURANCE GOLD STEPS OUT 25m UP-DIP OUTSIDE EXISTING MRE — 7.67 g/t AU OVER 14.7m AT EAGLE ZONE, BC (TSXV:EDG)
snippet: Endurance Gold Corp. (TSXV:EDG) released its first 2026 assays from the Reliance Gold Project in BC's Bridge River Mining Camp: DDH26-128 returned 7.67 g/t gold and 0.13% antimony over 14.7m from 75.9m at the Eagle Zone — a 25m up-dip expansion entirely outside the existing 1.45Moz Inferred Resource — while step-out DDH26-129 returned 12m at 3.07 g/t gold 60m along strike. Both holes point toward better near-surface continuity than the current MRE reflects, supporting the PEA planned for later in 2026.

headline: TROILUS DRILLS 157.5m OF 0.95 g/t AuEq IN Z87 RESERVE PIT — BULK GOLD-COPPER CONTINUITY CONFIRMED FOR QUEBEC OPEN PIT (TSX:TLG)
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX:TLG) announced June 25 results from 13 holes in its Z87 optimization program at the Troilus Project in north-central Quebec: the headline intercept of 157.5m grading 0.95 g/t AuEq (including 28m at 1.37 g/t AuEq) confirms broad bulk-tonnage continuity of mineralisation within the Z87 reserve pit shell as defined in the company's existing Feasibility Study. The program targets inferred material and previously unsampled intervals to improve strip ratio and mine sequencing ahead of a construction decision.

headline: 29METALS OIZON DRILLS 2.2m AT 5.1% Cu / 17.7 g/t Au / 126 g/t Ag — FIRST HIGH-GRADE ORE INTO GOLDEN GROVE BY YEAR-END (ASX:29M)
snippet: 29Metals (ASX:29M) reported June 25 resource extension and conversion drilling results at the Oizon zone of its Gossan Hill Mine at Golden Grove in Western Australia, headlined by 2.2m at 5.1% copper, 17.7 g/t gold, and 126 g/t silver from 402.4m downhole. Development to Oizon is on schedule, with first high-grade polymetallic ore expected to reach the mill by end-2026 — adding a premium ore source to an operation that has been under production pressure this year.

headline: 10 RIGS, 78,000m DRILLED: MINERALS 260 EXTENDS BULLABULLING AT DEPTH — PFS DUE JULY, NEW MRE AUGUST (ASX:MI6)
snippet: Minerals 260 (ASX:MI6) reported June 25 new drilling results extending gold mineralisation at depth at its 4.5Moz Bullabulling Project near Coolgardie in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields, including 20m at 3.4 g/t Au and 18m at 2.9 g/t Au across the Phoenix, Bacchus, and Dicksons deposits. With 78,000m drilled since the existing MRE and 10 rigs currently active, a Preliminary Feasibility Study is targeted for July 2026 and an MRE update incorporating 60 additional holes is targeted for August 2026.

headline: COMMERCE SECRETARY'S JUNE 30 COPPER REPORT COULD TRIGGER 15–30% TARIFF ON REFINED METAL FROM 2027 — NORTH AMERICAN MINERS WATCH
snippet: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces a June 30, 2026 deadline to deliver a formal assessment of the domestic copper market to President Trump — the precursor to a phased tariff on refined copper imports that would start at 15% on January 1, 2027 and escalate to 30% on January 1, 2028. While U.S. domestic fabricators depend structurally on imported refined copper, producers with North American smelting capacity — including Freeport-McMoRan, Hudbay Minerals, and Ivanhoe Electric — face no tariff burden and could command a domestic price premium that widens the CME-to-LME spread by $0.30–$0.80/lb according to Goldman Sachs estimates.

headline: SUMMER DOLDRUMS OR AUTUMN LAUNCHPAD? GOLDSEEK MAPS THE SEASONAL SETUP THAT PRECEDES GOLD'S BIGGEST RALLIES
snippet: A GoldSeek seasonal analysis argues gold's current June weakness — historically concentrated in a short window before the autumn rally — is unusually constructive in 2026: positioning has reset to pre-bull levels, physical demand from central banks and Chinese buyers is at record pace, and mining stock ETFs are set to amplify the seasonal rebound 2x to 3x relative to the metal. The analysis notes the autumn rally has historically gotten underway by mid-July, making the next three weeks the key accumulation window for both gold and mining equity investors.

headline: GDX EARNINGS AT 12.8x — GOLDSEEK: GOLD MINERS' P/E AT MULTI-YEAR LOW DESPITE RECORD OPERATING CASH FLOWS
snippet: A GoldSeek fundamental analysis finds major gold miners trading at just 12.8x earnings and mid-tiers at 10.9x — historically compressed multiples for producers generating near-record operating cash flows with gold above $4,000. The analysis argues the gap between earnings power and market valuation is unsustainable: when institutional capital rotates back from defensive assets after the current rate-hike cycle peaks, the mechanical re-rating from distressed to normalised valuations could deliver outsized returns well before gold itself makes new highs.
